title: Opinion Essays
goals: menyusun **esai opini** dengan thesis, alasan, contoh, dan kesimpulan
memakai **kata penghubung argumen** (firstly, however, in conclusion)

lesson.text: Esai opini menyatakan pendapatmu dan membuktikannya. Strukturnya: **pengantar** dengan thesis, **dua paragraf isi** (alasan dan contoh), dan **kesimpulan**. Unit ini melatih menyusun dan memeriksa esai pendek.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur esai opini
table: [[Many people use phones in class. I believe schools should limit this.]]
[[Secondly, phones can be useful if used properly. However, ...]]
[[In conclusion, schools should set clear rules.]]

lesson.title: Thesis harus jelas
lesson.text: Thesis bukan pertanyaan atau fakta. Salah: *This essay is about phones.* Benar: [[I believe schools should limit phone use.]]

lesson.title: Satu paragraf, satu alasan
lesson.text: Setiap paragraf isi berisi satu alasan, dijelaskan, lalu diberi contoh. Jangan menumpuk banyak alasan dalam satu paragraf.

items: Pengantar + thesis, dua paragraf isi, kesimpulan.
Firstly, Secondly, Finally; For example; However; In conclusion.
Thesis jelas dan berpihak.
Satu alasan per paragraf.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi esai opini pendek yang runtut.
items: Many students use phones in class.
I believe that schools should limit phone use during lessons.
Firstly, phones distract students from learning.
For example, they check messages instead of listening.
In conclusion, clear rules will help students focus.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi esai opini pendek yang runtut.
items: Some people think homework is unnecessary.
In my opinion, homework is useful in moderation.
Firstly, it helps students practise what they learn.
However, too much homework makes students tired.
To sum up, teachers should give a balanced amount.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi esai opini pendek yang runtut.
items: Public transport is better than private cars.
Firstly, it reduces traffic and pollution.
For instance, one bus can replace many cars.
Secondly, it is cheaper for most people.
Therefore, cities should invest in public transport.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi esai opini pendek yang runtut.
items: Learning English is important for young people.
Firstly, it helps them find better jobs.
Secondly, it allows them to access information online.
Some people argue that it is too difficult.
However, with daily practice, everyone can improve.
practice.exp: Thesis, dua alasan, pandangan lain, bantahan.

options: I believe schools should start later in the morning.
This essay is about the time when schools start in the morning.
School starts early in many countries, and students wake up early.
Is it good for students to start school at an early time?
In my opinion, cities need more bicycle lanes.
There are many cities in the world, and each one is different.
Bicycles have two wheels, and people ride them on the road.
I will write about bicycles and how people use them in cities.
For example,
In conclusion,
However,
Firstly,
In conclusion,
For instance,
Secondly,
Although,

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk mengakui pandangan lain:
options: Some people argue that ... However, ...
Everyone knows that ... so nobody can disagree at all.
I do not care about ... and I will not discuss it here.
Nobody thinks that ... so there is nothing else to say.

practice.q: Berapa alasan sebaiknya ada dalam satu paragraf isi?
options: satu alasan dengan contoh
lima alasan
tidak ada
semua alasan sekaligus
practice.exp: Fokus. Jawaban yang tepat: **satu alasan dengan contoh**.

options: di pengantar
di kesimpulan saja
di tengah paragraf isi
di judul saja
To sum up, schools should set clear rules about phones.
And that is all I wanted to say about phones and schools today.
Phones are phones, and schools are schools, in every country.
The end of the essay is here, so please stop reading now.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat pendukung yang paling kuat:
options: For example, one bus can carry sixty people, while a car carries four.
Buses are nice and I like them because they are very big.
I like buses very much, and I ride them every day to school.
Buses exist in many cities, and they have many seats inside.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH sebagai thesis:
options: This essay will discuss homework.
I believe homework should be limited.
In my opinion, homework helps students.
I strongly think homework is necessary.

items: Many people think the internet is dangerous.
I believe it is useful when used carefully.
Firstly, it gives us fast access to information.
Secondly, it also helps us talks with friends.
In conclusion, the internet is a good tool.
Some people prefer living in cities.
In my opinion, villages is better for children.
They are quiet and safe.
Therefore, families should consider moving.
